facts.fact: Tanger Med has road connections from Tangier; foot passengers have a separate terminal and internal boarding transfer, so arrival and check-in must be budgeted separately from an old-city walk.

Pedestrian and buses passengers Pedestrian and buses passengers access the port through Tanger Med Port Center, which provides direct access to the ferry terminal. Police and Customs inspections are carried out in the maritime station. An intra-port shuttle service ensures the transfer of passengers on foot and by buses directly to the boarding zone.
